# Digests the daily GHCR prune must keep, even though no live tag points
# at them any more. Read by .github/scripts/prune-ghcr-versions.py.
#
#   sha256:<64 hex>  YYYY-MM-DD(expiry, inclusive)  reason
#
# Every entry expires: this is for bridging a downstream pin until it
# moves to a supported tag, not a second retention policy. Children of a
# listed index (per-arch manifests, attestations) are kept automatically.
# A malformed line makes the prune refuse to run.

# RasQberry Two beta pins this Quantum Lab image (QuBins#167). It was
# built 2026-10-02 and pruned 2026-10-06; restored from GHCR's 30-day
# deleted-versions window. Expires when RasQberry has moved to a
# snapshot tag.
sha256:a686b45167d42743c90bcd2e32ee10294de39528a5fe37b2651dcdfab3119884  2027-01-31  RasQberry Two beta pin (#167)
